output.fix: Fix this on the IdP side. Grant admin consent for the application, or have users complete an interactive consent flow once. Also check that the users or groups are assigned to the app and that any access policy is satisfied. Confirm the authorization request targets the correct tenant endpoint. After that, retry prompt=none. If prompt=none still fails, fall back to an interactive prompt=login or prompt=consent flow. Don't weaken any validation to get around this.
